headline: Shrimp Farm Management Software
intro: Track feed, water quality, growth, sampling, inventory, harvests, farm finance, and biological risk across every pond in one connected platform.
heroOrson: Orson connects the dots across your ponds.
scroll: Scroll to move through your farm
journeyLabel: Explore three ponds through an underwater journey
waterLabel: Light blue underwater waves flow toward you as you scroll through three ponds.
platformIntro: Give every feeding, water check, and sampling a place in the bigger picture. Explore what Shrimply brings together.

features.label: Growth & sampling
features.title: See how your shrimp are really growing.
features.description: Turn sampling records into a clearer view of average weight, daily growth, survival, and biomass. Keep every cycle in perspective, right through harvest.
points: Follow growth across the whole cycle
Connect sampling, mortality, and harvest records

features.label: Water quality
features.title: See the trend behind every reading.
features.description: Keep dissolved oxygen, pH, temperature, and other water records together. Follow changes over time and give your team the context for the next pond check.
points: Review water-quality history for each pond
Connect changing conditions with growth records

features.label: Feed & inventory
features.title: Know what goes in. Know what’s left.
features.description: Connect daily feeding with feed stock. Actual feeding deducts inventory, while sampling records stay focused on crop performance and feed-conversion tracking.
points: Track daily feed totals by pond
Keep stock levels and reorder thresholds in view

features.label: Finance & reports
features.title: Bring the business side into focus.
features.description: Connect farm spending and harvest income. Review cash flow, production costs, profit and loss, and assumption-based projections in dedicated reports.
points: Keep cash flow separate from profitability
Share clear PDF reports with your team

panelFooter: A clearer view, one record at a time.

orsonIntro: A water reading is a moment. Your pond history is the bigger picture. Orson uses a frontier model for reasoning, connecting recent water quality, sampling, and feed records to help you understand what needs a closer look.
orsonFootnote: Grounded in your farm’s recorded history.
question: What should I check before increasing feed in Pond A1?
answer: Your daily feed total has risen over the last five days, while morning oxygen readings have moved lower.
advice: Before the next increase, check feed trays, current oxygen, and the latest biomass estimate. More feed logged does not tell us how much the shrimp ate.
nextAction: Record a tray check and fresh water readings.
responseCaption: Illustrative response using sample pond records.
workflowEyebrow: FROM THE POND EDGE TO YOUR HAND
workflowIntro: Capture the work where it happens. Bring the same records to the people planning what comes next.

steps.title: Record in the field.
steps.body: Log feeding, water checks, and sampling on mobile. Work offline and sync when your connection returns.

steps.title: See the whole farm.
steps.body: Review pond histories, inventory, and team activity from the web. Keep everyone working from connected records.
steps.tag: A shared view in the office

steps.title: Plan with perspective.
steps.body: Use Orson’s insights and farm reports to review risks, understand costs, and prepare your next move.
